Each unit has been thoughtfully renovated while preserving original character, offering the perfect blend of historic charm and modern living.  The property features a 1 bedroom unit on the first floor, a spacious 2 bedroom unit on the second floor, and a 1 bedroom unit on the third floor. All apartments are fully updated and currently rented, showcasing modern kitchens and bathrooms, hardwood floors throughout, and original architectural details that add warmth and character.  A grand interior front staircase and wraparound porch enhance the building's curb appeal, while vinyl siding provides low-maintenance ownership. Each unit offers the rare convenience of both front and rear entrances, along with fire-escape back stairs for added functionality.  Additional highlights include ample off-street parking and separately metered utilities, with tenants paying their own gas heat and electric, making this a smart, efficient investment. Centrally located near downtown amenities, dining, shopping, transportation, and nightlife, this property offers strong rental appeal and lifestyle flexibility.
